plugins.name: gcp-bigquery
plugins.description: Google's BigQuery remote MCP server: list datasets and tables and run SQL queries, acting with your own Google Cloud IAM permissions. Authenticates with a gcloud access token from GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: gcp-cloud-run
plugins.description: Google's Cloud Run remote MCP server: list, inspect, and deploy Cloud Run services, acting with your own Google Cloud IAM permissions. Authenticates with a gcloud access token from GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: gcp-gke
plugins.description: Google's GKE remote MCP server: inspect clusters, node pools, Kubernetes resources, events, and logs, with tools that can change them, acting with your own Google Cloud IAM permissions. Authenticates with a gcloud access token from GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.description: GitLab's official remote MCP server: projects, issues, merge requests, pipelines, and code search on GitLab.com or self-managed GitLab. Signs in with OAuth.

plugins.name: google-developer-knowledge
plugins.description: Google's Developer Knowledge MCP server: search and read official Google developer documentation for Google Cloud, Firebase, Android, Maps, and more. Read-only. Authenticates with an API key from DEVELOPERKNOWLEDGE_API_KEY.

plugins.name: sonarqube
plugins.description: The SonarQube Cloud-hosted MCP server, read-only: issues, quality gates, coverage, security hotspots, and measures, in the EU or US region or on SonarQube Server. Authenticates with a user token from SONARQUBE_TOKEN.

plugins.name: terraform
plugins.description: HashiCorp's remote Terraform MCP server (beta): the Terraform Registry, your private registry, and HCP Terraform workspaces, runs, and variables. Authenticates with an HCP Terraform API token from TFE_TOKEN.
